spec.name: Orange Kitchen Mature cucumber Crop
spec.description: An airy cucumber vine rooted at y0, with layered angular heart-shaped leaves, climbing stems, a curled tendril and three hanging cucumbers. Stepped fruit ends and painted longitudinal ridges distinguish it from a bush crop. All geometry stays inside x2..14, z2..14, y0..16.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. A mature planted cucumber crop with botanically recognizable growth: appropriate leaves/stems, ripe edible parts and realistic species-specific plant silhouette in Minecraft cuboids. Airy gaps, layered leaf shapes, leaf veins, natural plant clusters. NOT a generic tomato bush recolored. Rooted at y0, x2..14,z2..14,y0..16. No pot or dirt block. All growth-stage variants will be based on this model.
